title: Three things to watch amid Anthropic’s latest feud with the government
raw_excerpt: This story originally appeared in The Algorithm, our weekly newsletter on AI. To get stories like this in your inbox first, sign up here . For those of you enjoying your summer unaware of Anthropic’s latest feud with the US government, here’s a recap: In April the company said it had built an AI model called Mythos that was so good at working with code it could pose a global cybersecurity threat. Anthropic gave access to a small group of cybersecurity experts so they could see what they were up against. Then it released a modified version called Fable which it said was safer to the public on Tuesday, June 9. That Friday, the federal government told the company it was a threat to national security and placed export controls on the new release. Anthropic revoked access to both models hours later. People worried about catastrophic effects of AI—broadly labeled “doomers”—have said for years that the technology poses a threat to humanity and published proposals for how the government should intervene in its development. The doomers just got their government intervention—not over a bioweapon or rogue AI, but in response to an AI model that’s basically just really good at coding. And the result so far looks less like a safety plan than like a superficial reaction. There’s plenty to dissect about what happened in those few days that led to such drastic action from the government, and it’s notable that Amazon CEO Andy Jassy was the one who told government officials that Fable would b…
summary: Anthropic 与美国政府的最新冲突持续升级。该公司此前声称其新模型 Mythos 具备全球网络安全威胁能力，仅向少数专家开放，随后发布了更安全的版本 Fable。然而，白宫以“越狱”为由暂停了这些模型的部署，Anthropic 认为这一要求无法实现。事件凸显了 AI 安全监管与模型能力之间的紧张关系，也引发了关于出口管制和国家安全的新讨论。

title: Daybreak: Tools for securing every organization in the world
raw_excerpt: OpenAI introduces new Daybreak tools, including Codex Security and GPT-5.5-Cyber, to help organizations find, validate, and patch vulnerabilities at scale.
summary: OpenAI 推出 Daybreak 安全工具集，包括 Codex Security 和 GPT-5.5-Cyber，旨在帮助组织大规模发现、验证和修补漏洞。该举措标志着 OpenAI 在 AI 安全领域的重大投入，通过将 AI 能力直接应用于网络安全，有望改变传统漏洞管理的效率和规模，对全球企业安全防护具有重要影响。

title: Nvidia says its AI data center design runs hotter to use a lot less water
raw_excerpt: Public pushback against data centers has emphasized their water and energy consumption , and now Nvidia is highlighting its claim that the Rubin generation reference design for a fully liquid-cooled data center has "eliminated massive amounts of power usage and pretty much all water usage." Still, it doesn't address all of the concerns around AI data centers, including during their construction, and for the power generation requirements of the massive facilities. summary: Nvidia 发布 Rubin 代数据中心参考设计，采用全液冷方案，声称可“消除大量电力消耗和几乎所有用水”。该设计针对 AI 数据中心日益增长的能耗和水耗问题，通过提高运行温度来减少冷却需求。尽管未解决建设过程中的所有环境担忧，但这一创新为可持续 AI 基础设施提供了新思路，可能推动行业标准变革。

title: calesthio/OpenMontage
raw_excerpt: World's first open-source, agentic video production system. 12 pipelines, 52 tools, 500+ agent skills. Turn your AI coding assistant into a full video production studio.
summary: OpenMontage 作为全球首个开源、智能体驱动的视频制作系统发布，包含 12 条流水线、52 个工具和 500 多项智能体技能。该项目可将 AI 编码助手转变为完整的视频制作工作室，大幅降低了视频创作的门槛。其开源特性有望推动 AI 视频生成领域的民主化创新，吸引开发者和内容创作者广泛参与。

title: 阿里发布视频生成模型HappyHorse 1.1：五大维度全面升级
summary: 阿里发布视频生成模型 HappyHorse 1.1，在五大维度实现全面升级。该模型在视频质量、连贯性、多样性、可控性和生成速度等方面均有显著提升，进一步巩固了阿里在多模态生成领域的竞争力。HappyHorse 1.1 的发布为视频内容创作提供了更强大的 AI 工具，有望在广告、影视、社交等领域广泛应用。

title: Nobel laureate John Jumper is leaving DeepMind for rival Anthropic
raw_excerpt: Nobel laureate John Jumper is leaving DeepMind for Anthropic after nine years. Jumper, who co-led the AlphaFold team, won a Nobel Prize for predicting protein structures. His departure follows struggles at DeepMind in selling coding tools to businesses.
summary: 诺贝尔奖得主、AlphaFold 联合负责人 John Jumper 在 DeepMind 工作九年后离职，加入竞争对手 Anthropic。Jumper 因蛋白质结构预测获得诺贝尔奖，其离职反映了 DeepMind 在商业化（尤其是编码工具销售）方面的困境，也凸显了 Anthropic 在 AI 前沿研究领域的人才吸引力。这一变动可能重塑 AI 研究格局。

title: Inception Labs' Mercury 2 AI Beats Google's DiffusionGemma at Its Own Game
raw_excerpt: Mercury 2 is a reasoning language model that generates about 1,000 tokens per second. It uses diffusion, the same trick that turns static into a photo in image generators like Stable Diffusion. The model is best for speed-sensitive, high-volume parts of workflows rather than the hardest frontier reasoning. It is only available via API/cloud.
summary: Inception Labs 发布 Mercury 2 推理语言模型，采用扩散生成技术，每秒可生成约 1000 个 token，速度超越 Google 的 DiffusionGemma。该模型适用于对速度敏感的高吞吐量场景，而非最难的推理任务。Mercury 2 仅通过 API/云服务提供，展示了扩散模型在语言生成领域的潜力，可能推动实时 AI 应用的发展。

title: Sakana Fugu
raw_excerpt: Sakana Fugu is a multi-agent system that behaves like a single model. Fugu can decide whether to handle requests directly or coordinate a team of expert models. It manages model selection, delegation, verification, and synthesis. Users simply call one model, and a coordinated system of experts does the work. Sakana Fugu and Fugu Ultra are available today through a single OpenAI-compatible API.
summary: Sakana 发布 Fugu 多智能体系统，它像一个单一模型一样工作，但内部可协调多个专家模型。Fugu 能自主决定是直接处理请求还是组建专家团队，并管理模型选择、委派、验证和合成。用户只需调用一个模型，即可获得协调的专家系统服务。Fugu 和 Fugu Ultra 现已通过 OpenAI 兼容 API 提供，代表了多智能体系统的新范式。

title: PP-OCRv6 on Hugging Face: 50-Language OCR from 1.5M to 34.5M Parameters
summary: PP-OCRv6 在 Hugging Face 上发布，支持 50 种语言，模型参数规模从 150 万到 3450 万不等。该 OCR 系统由 PaddlePaddle 团队开发，在精度和效率上取得平衡，覆盖多种语言场景。其开源发布将促进多语言文档数字化、自动化办公等应用，尤其对非英语语言的 OCR 能力提升具有重要意义。
